prompt: Give me an idea for a hackathon project
response: A great hackathon project idea could be a mobile app that uses augmented reality to help users learn a new language by translating real-world objects and signs in real-time. This would combine cutting-edge AR technology with a practical application that could benefit many people. You could use existing APIs for translation and AR, focusing on creating a user-friendly interface and experience. This project would be innovative and has the potential to be very useful.
